description: Age in complete years on a date and the exact dates a minimum or maximum age is reached (leap-day births) — For up to 100 people, computes age in complete years and months on a caller asOf date, the date they reach each minimum age (the birthday) and the first day they exceed each maximum age, and checks min/max age requirements; 29 February births need a declared common-year rule (28 February or 1 March) because jurisdictions differ. Built for an agent checking eligibility (18+, under 65, 21 to buy). I

maxAgeYears.description: Inclusive: age must still be at most this many complete years.

leapDayRule.description: In common years a 29 February birthday is observed on 28 February or on 1 March depending on the legal context you apply; you must choose. Required if any birth date is 29 February.

name: age-threshold
